verdicts.correction: Mostly right. Two details are incomplete. (1) economy.roblox.com/docs/json/v1 ALSO returns 404, not only auth; docsiteassets .../legacy/economy/v1.json and .../auth/v1.json both return 200. (2) The docsiteassets v2 docs return 403 for users, friends and thumbnails too, not only economy, presence and premiumfeatures. I also checked the DevForum JSON: OP LeafGreen888 is in the Roblox_Staff group. The post was edited to v3 on 2026-04-20, and the last reply was 2026-09-04. The post also lists 'Sunsetting endpoints' as a planned change type.

Re-observed without a cookie: 401 {"errors":[{"code":9002,"subcode":0,"message":"Authentication token is missing"}]}, x-ratelimit-limit '100, 100;w=60'. Swagger confirms AuthenticatedGetUserResponse {id,name,displayName} and the siblings age-bracket, country-code and roles. The invalid-cookie result (9002, subcode 3, 'User is not authenticated', '300, 300;w=60') exists in agildw/roblox-presence-tracker docs/429-incident.md, but that file carries NO date (the 'Oct 2026' attribution is not supported). It was not independently verified because no cookie may be sent.

Only a community source backs this, and the rules stopped me from testing it with a cookie. The finding also misquotes that source. The doc says the invalid-cookie presence response was '7 records, byte-identical to the authenticated shape', served 'as anonymous, under the much stricter unauthenticated limiter'. It does not say 'byte-identical to the no-cookie response'. The doc has no date. Its rate-header comparison is: no cookie '60, 60;w=60', invalid '60, 60;w=60', valid '60, 60;w=60, 100;w=60'. The design advice (only treat users/authenticated 401 as invalid) is still sound.

Re-observed for id 1: 200 with the fields listed, x-ratelimit-limit '30, 30;w=60', cache-control no-cache. Id 0 returns 404 code 3 'The user id is invalid.' Swagger confirms that externalAppDisplayName is always null and that x-roblox-recommended-alternatives points to Open Cloud. apis.roblox.com/cloud/v2/users/1 without a key returns 403 {"errors":[{"code":0,"message":"Invalid authentication data provided"}]}.

Confirmed: 200 ids return 200, 201 ids return 400 code 1 'Too many ids.', rate header '1000, 1000;w=1'. Swagger maxItems is 200 and carries the no-CSRF note. Additions: swagger gives no maxItems for usernames, but live 201 usernames returns 400 code 2 'Too many usernames.' while 101 returns 200, so the effective cap is 200. POST /v1/usernames/users has a DIFFERENT limit: '500, 500;w=60' without a cookie. The requestedUsername field is confirmed live.

All verified. The swagger size enum is exactly 11 values, format is Png|Jpeg|Webp, and includeBackground and includeProfileFrame exist. Live: 101 ids returns 400 code 1. 999x999 and 30x30 return 400 code 3 with field 'size'. format=Gif returns 400 code 2 with field 'format'. A nonexistent id is silently omitted. Header '120, 120;w=60'. Data Stewardship row: Unauth 120 (from 10000), Cookie 500 (from 10000).

Confirmed: Pending and Blocked rows have imageUrl "", and a Blocked row can instead carry a placeholder tr.rbxcdn.com URL. Bloxstrap ThumbnailResponse.cs documents the states Error, Completed, InReview, Pending, Blocked and TemporarilyUnavailable. Thumbnails.cs uses RETRIES=5 with a 500ms*i delay and retries only while State=='Pending', via POST /v1/batch. Nuance: '~2 s' is optimistic for large sizes. In my 720x720 Jpeg test, all 30 rows were Pending first and 1 was still Pending after 3 s. Also, Bloxstrap re-polls the whole request, not only the Pending ids.

The host finding is confirmed: freshly generated 720x720 Jpeg headshots came from t0, t1, t2, t4, t5, t6 and t7.rbxcdn.com in the size-less form https://t6.rbxcdn.com/30DAY-AvatarHeadshot-<HASH>-Jpeg. At 352 and 150 every URL was on tr.rbxcdn.com. One detail is WRONG. tr.rbxcdn.com does NOT return image/Png for a Webp path: .../AvatarHeadshot/Webp/noFilter returned 'Content-Type: image/Webp' with RIFF/WEBP bytes. The .../Png/noFilter path returned 'image/Png'. So Content-Type follows the format path segment, using non-standard capitalisation. t6 returned 'image/jpeg' with 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000'; tr returned 'Cache-Control: no-cache' with a large Age.

Re-observed: 200 {data:[{requestId,errorCode:0,errorMessage:"",targetId,state,imageUrl,version}]}, rate header '60, 60;w=1'. Swagger lists token, alias, the Roblox-Place-Id header, and 400 codes 1/2/3/4/7 plus 403 code 9. The endpoint is not in the Data Stewardship list (string search of the OP).

Swagger has exactly one path, GET /v1/user/currency, returning {robux:int64}. Live: /v1/user/currency returns 401 9002 with '500, 500;w=60'; /v1/users/1/currency returns 401 9002 with '20, 20;w=60'; /v1/users/1/doesnotexist and /v2/users/1/currency return 404 code 0. noblox getUserFunds still calls //economy.roblox.com/v1/users/${userId}/currency and reads robux.

Swagger confirms x-documentation-category Hidden and 'Endpoint planned for deprecation on 4/30 (Roblox Plus launch)' on both validate-membership and premium-upsell-precheck. Live: 401 9002 with '30, 30;w=60'; a bogus sibling path returns 404. The live ProfileHeader bundle builds '/v1/users/<id>/validate-membership' withCredentials. noblox resolves res.body === 'true'. I could not verify the body shape with a cookie. Press coverage confirms Plus at $4.99/mo from 30 Apr 2026 and the end of new Premium sign-ups. Premium benefits ending 30 May 2026 include the 10% Robux bonus and the Premium PROFILE BADGE, so a 'Premium' badge in RoALT would not match roblox.com after that date.

Confirmed in the live FriendsCarousel bundle. The body is {userIds, fields:["names.combinedName","isVerified","hasRobloxSubscription"]}, and the bundle maps isRobloxPlus = hasRobloxSubscription === true. The Navigation bundle uses access-management upsell-feature-access?featureName=IsRobloxPlusSubscribed and checks "Granted"===data.access. Live: 200 ids return 200, 201 ids return {profileDetails:[],errors:[]}, header '10000, 10000;w=60', and upsell-feature-access without a cookie returns 403 problem+json. TWO CORRECTIONS. (1) An unknown field only empties the result when it is the ONLY field. With fields ["names.username","isPremium"] the API returns rows with just names.username, silently dropping the unknown field. So a row-count assertion will not catch a typo; check that each requested key is present. (2) Nonexistent ids are NOT omitted: id 9999999999999 returned {userId, names:{username:null}}, and deleted accounts show username null or 'Account Deleted'. The engine property Player.HasRobloxSubscription (added 2026-03-10 per DevForum) corroborates the field name.

Live for id 1: friends 0, followers 16821485, followings 0, each '100, 100;w=60'. Swagger: Hidden, RedesignNeededBeforeAutomation, x-documentation-category-target-date 2026-06-01T00:00:00.000Z. FriendsCountResponse.count is int32 and FollowCountResponse.count is int64. 'Friends Are Back!' (RajAdventures, 2 Apr 2026) says 'There are no API changes.' Data Stewardship rows match: the followers and followings LISTS lost unauthenticated access, and /v1/my/friends/count is 100 rpm with a cookie.

Mostly confirmed: /friends returns 98 rows with name and displayName "" at '20, 20;w=60'. /friends/find paging matches (page 1 has 50 rows and NextCursor '1:636167423083800000'; page 2 has 48 rows and NextCursor null; HasMore is null). limit=51 returns 400 code 6. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: unauthenticated /friends/find works ONLY with userSort omitted or userSort=2 (the default). userSort=0 and userSort=1 return HTTP 401 with an EMPTY body (content-length 0, no 9002 JSON). So the roblox.com form '?userSort=1' needs a cookie. Without a cookie, findFriendsType=1 returns 403 {code:1,'The target user is invalid or does not exist.'}. Swagger FriendResponse also lists hasVerifiedBadge, but it was not returned live. The live FriendsCarousel only fetches the first page of /friends/find (no cursor loop).

Swagger: Hidden with reason RequiresHumanPresence; only the userSort param. Schema UserPresenceResponse {userPresence{UserPresenceType:string, UserLocationType:string, lastLocation, placeId, rootPlaceId, gameInstanceId(uuid), universeId, lastOnline}, sortScore, id, name, displayName}. Live without a cookie: 401 9002, '100, 100;w=60'. The FriendsCarousel bundle reads UserPresenceType==='InGame', gameInstanceId and universeId, then calls get-profiles. The 200 body itself was not verified, since that needs a cookie.

Confirmed: the OpenAPI 3 schema has no lastOnline, the enum is [0,1,2,3], 51 ids return 400 code 3, 50 return 200, last-online and /v2/presence/users return 404, and the header is '60, 60;w=60'. DevForum staff posts #74 (28 Oct 2024) and #79 (15 Nov 2024, 'will begin returning an arbitrary value') confirmed. Additions: a June 2025 DevForum post shows the swagger then still listed lastOnline and invisibleModeExpiry, so their removal from the doc is recent. Any userId <= 0 fails the WHOLE batch with 400 {code:2,'Invalid User.'}. A body without userIds returns 400 {code:1,'Invalid Request, user Ids cannot be null.'}. Duplicate ids are deduped to one row. Unknown positive ids get an offline 'Website' row. GET on /v1/presence/users returns 404, not 405.

Only community evidence supports this. DevForum 3760427 (June 2025, no staff reply) says that without a cookie only basic fields came back, and that sending a Cookie header fixed it. The claim that your own cookie returns your own gameId is inference. Unauthenticated calls always returned nulls for ids 1 and 156, which is consistent with the claim but does not prove it.

Swagger EmailResponse {emailAddress (masked), verified, canBypassPasswordForEmailUpdate}. /v1/emails returns CurrentEmailsResponse {verifiedEmail, pendingEmail}, both masked. Both are Hidden with reason AgainstPolicy. Live: 401 9002 with '10000, 10000;w=60'. accountinformation /v1/email returns 404; that host only has POST /v1/email/verify.

Swagger and live behaviour match: 400 {code:1,'Invalid challenge ID.'} without a cookie, '3000, 3000;w=60', and the mediaType enum Email=0 to Passkey=7. Public GET twostepverification.roblox.com/v1/metadata returns 200 with flags such as twoStepVerificationEnabled.

Confirmed: AccountPinStatusResponse {isEnabled, unlockedUntil(double)}, 401 9002, '1000, 1000;w=60'. Besides PATCH, POST and DELETE /v1/account/pin also exist (all mutating, all need CSRF). /v1/phone returns 401 9002 without a cookie and its PhoneResponse fields are confirmed. Data Stewardship lists 'Unauthenticated access removed' for GET /v1/phone.

The live CoreUtilities bundle defines 'x-csrf-token', 'rblx-challenge-id', 'rblx-challenge-type', 'rblx-challenge-metadata' and 'x-retry-attempt'. It also keeps the current CSRF token in localStorage and attaches it to outgoing requests. noblox getGeneralToken POSTs //auth.roblox.com/v2/logout. Unauthenticated POSTs to presence, thumbnails/batch and get-profiles succeeded without a token.

I did not re-trigger a 429, to stay polite. The fixture headers match, and they also include 'x-envoy-ratelimited: true', which the finding omits. All per-endpoint unauthenticated limits listed were re-observed today. Missing from the list: POST /v1/usernames/users '500, 500;w=60', accountinformation /v1/metadata '1000, 1000;w=60', auth /v1/account/pin '1000, 1000;w=60', accountsettings email '10000, 10000;w=60'. The create.roblox.com presence page (last_updated 2026-10-23) says 'Retry with exponential backoff (start at 1s).'

The 404-vs-401 split holds: bogus paths under users/authenticated/, economy/v1/user/, accountsettings, friends/v1/my/ and auth/v1/account/ all return 404 {code:0,message:''}. Two corrections. (1) Not every live auth-gated route answers with the 9002 JSON: friends/find?userSort=0|1 returns 401 with an EMPTY body. A health probe must key on the status code only and tolerate an empty body. (2) Method matters: GET on the POST-only presence/v1/presence/users returns 404, not 405. A probe that uses the wrong method will report a live route as removed. The PresenceStatus bundle still references '/v1/presence/last-online' (confirmed).

missed.claim: friends/find sort modes 0 and 1 need a cookie, and their 401 has an empty body
missed.detail: GET friends.roblox.com/v1/users/261/friends/find?userSort=0&limit=50 and ?userSort=1 both return HTTP 401 with content-length 0 when sent without a cookie. ?userSort=2, or no userSort, returns 200. roblox.com's FriendsCarousel conditionally uses '?userSort=1' with credentials. findFriendsType=1 without a cookie returns 403 {code:1,'The target user is invalid or does not exist.'}. RoALT should page friends/find unauthenticated with userSort omitted, or pass a cookie when it wants sort 1. Error parsing must tolerate empty 401 bodies.

missed.claim: Presence batch validation: one bad id fails the whole request
missed.detail: POST presence.roblox.com/v1/presence/users with any userId <= 0 (e.g. [0]) returns 400 {"errors":[{"code":2,"message":"Invalid User."}]} for the whole batch. {} returns 400 {code:1,'Invalid Request, user Ids cannot be null.'}. Duplicate ids are deduped ([1,1,1] gives one row). Unknown positive ids return an offline row with lastLocation 'Website'. RoALT should filter out ids <= 0 and dedupe before batching (max 50 without a cookie).

missed.claim: get-profiles drops unknown fields silently and returns null-name rows for missing users
missed.detail: POST apis.roblox.com/user-profile-api/v1/user/profiles/get-profiles with fields ["names.username","isPremium"] returns 200 with only names.username; the unknown field is silently dropped. With ONLY unknown fields it returns []. Id 9999999999999 returns {userId, names:{username:null}}; deleted accounts show null or 'Account Deleted'. Validation should check that every requested key is present per row, not only the row count. When asked only for names.combinedName, names contains only combinedName.

missed.claim: Thumbnail CDN Content-Type uses non-standard capitalisation
missed.detail: tr.rbxcdn.com returns 'Content-Type: image/Webp' for a .../Webp/... path and 'image/Png' for .../Png/.... t*.rbxcdn.com returns 'image/jpeg'. Any MIME check in Rust or the webview must be case-insensitive, or should sniff magic bytes (the Webp response starts with RIFF....WEBP). Cache headers also differ: tr sends 'Cache-Control: no-cache' and t* sends 'public, max-age=31536000'.

missed.claim: usernames lookup cap is 200 and it has its own rate limit
missed.detail: POST users.roblox.com/v1/usernames/users: 201 usernames returns 400 {code:2,'Too many usernames.'}; 101 returns 200. Swagger gives no maxItems. The unauthenticated header is '500, 500;w=60', which is much tighter than POST /v1/users at '1000, 1000;w=1'. It also matches previous usernames, with requestedUsername echoed.

missed.claim: Ban/moderation status: usermoderation.roblox.com/v1/not-approved is live but undocumented
missed.detail: GET https://usermoderation.roblox.com/v1/not-approved without a cookie returns 401 9002 with '10000, 10000;w=60', so the route is alive. usermoderation.roblox.com/docs/json/v1 returns 404 and docsiteassets .../legacy/usermoderation/v1.json returns 403, so no published schema exists. Response field names are UNCONFIRMED. www.roblox.com/not-approved redirects to login. For public detection, users/{id}.isBanned (A3) is the documented signal. How users/authenticated behaves for a banned or warned account's cookie is unknown.

missed.claim: Staff replies in the Data Stewardship thread signal that alt-account tooling is under scrutiny
missed.detail: In devforum.roblox.com/t/4579220, reply #57 (LeafGreen888, Roblox_Staff, 16 Apr 2026) asks a user 'why you need to check presence for your alt accounts' and which endpoints they used. Reply #58 says 'Apps and tools will need to update to Open Cloud equivalents'. The OP lists 'Sunsetting endpoints' as a planned change type and promises to 'update this list as new API plans are defined'. RoALT should keep presence polling user-triggered and plan for unannounced removals.

missed.claim: No 2025-2026 removals announced for the account-info endpoints; watch the official deprecation thread
missed.detail: The 'Official List of Deprecated Web Endpoints' thread (62889) up to post #125 (2026-10-12) has no removal notice for the users, thumbnails, presence, friends, economy, premiumfeatures, accountsettings, 2SV or auth endpoints used here. The last relevant notice is presence last-online (#74 on 2024-10-28, #79 on 2024-11-15). Related: #124 (2026-09-23) changes the Open Cloud user-thumbnail operations from 26 Oct 2026, so unapproved avatars return 200 done:true with an error object instead of 503. That only matters if RoALT ever uses Open Cloud thumbnails.

missed.claim: Large headshots can stay Pending for more than 3 s
missed.detail: 30 uncached ids at 720x720 Jpeg with includeBackground=true were all Pending on the first call. After about 3 s, 28 were Completed, 1 was still Pending and 1 was Blocked. Smaller sizes (352x352 Webp) had 3 of 99 Pending, and all resolved within about 2 s. Use a retry budget of at least 5 tries with linear 0.5 s steps (Bloxstrap's pattern totals 5 s), and show a placeholder afterwards.

missed.claim: Roblox Plus has no official per-userId web API, and the Premium profile badge ended 30 May 2026
missed.detail: DevForum feature request 4606900 (30 Apr 2026, no staff reply) confirms there is no official way to check Plus by userId. The engine exposes Player.HasRobloxSubscription (added 2026-03-10, v0.712), which matches get-profiles' hasRobloxSubscription naming. Press coverage says the Premium profile badge and the 10% Robux bonus were discontinued from 30 May 2026, so a 'Premium' badge in RoALT would show something roblox.com itself no longer displays.
